crossRefs.note: After the earthquake a fire passed; but Yahweh was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.
crossRefs.keyword: there, etc. or, I heard a still voice

translations.web: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,
translations.bsb: It stood still, but I could not discern its appearance; a form loomed before my eyes, and I heard a whispering voice:
translations.kjv: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice,
translations.asv: It stood still, but I could not discern the appearance thereof; A form was before mine eyes: There was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
